btm_source_workbook_review.private_workbook_limitations: These research copies alter several thickness strings and include additional sites. B-TmR has 89 positive rows and a separate 116-row zero table whose observational status and detection limits were not verified. It is not substituted for the published source.

source_semantics.ranges: Thirteen source ranges were reduced to single endpoints or midpoints in the accepted table; their geological/measurement interpretation remains to be checked before an interval likelihood is chosen.
source_semantics.spots: Two source entries explicitly describe spots; treating them as representative undisturbed thickness is unverified.
source_semantics.suigetsu: Source row 49 is <0.1 cm; current CSV row 82 uses exact 0.1 cm.
source_semantics.kushu: Source row 48 reports no visible ash layer, with cryptotephra presence described in supporting text; current CSV row 84 uses exact 0.1 cm without a source-established bulk thickness.
source_semantics.absence: Supporting text discusses marine preservation and reporting limitations; unreported layered ash is not automatically zero original fallout.

btm_input_sensitivity.source_table: Yang et al. (2021), Supplementing dataset 1, thickness_data!A48:F49

source_evidence.82: Lake Suigetsu is reported as <0.1 cm.

btm_input_sensitivity.sensitivity_assumption: Use the documented 0.1 cm upper bound for Suigetsu. Remove Kushu from the quantitative thickness likelihood without interpreting it as zero or denying its reported presence. No detection threshold is invented.
btm_input_sensitivity.scope: Two-observation sensitivity with source-focused geometry and unchanged priors. Other source ranges, spots, and unverified proximal observations remain unresolved. No new geographic evaluation or full input replacement.

input.input_transformation: Original CSV row 82 becomes an upper bound; row 84 supplies no quantitative thickness likelihood. All other accepted rows and arrays are unchanged.

prior.name: baseline
prior.kernel_weights: Symmetric Dirichlet(total concentration kernel_concentration) over Gaussian, exponential, power components, shared across fans
prior.noise: HalfNormal(noise_scale); broad-error fraction Beta(1,9), fourfold residual SD
prior.interpretation: Proper modelling assumptions, not extra observations or geological facts. Identical prior specification for every eruption.
prior.angular_prior: Independent Normal(0,angular_sd) coefficients; no fitted displacement

volume.interpretation: 95% equal-tailed Bayesian credible interval conditional on this likelihood, prior and field family. Includes parameter and fan uncertainty; excludes unknown systematic preservation, sampling and source-attribution bias. Not dense-rock equivalent or ignimbrite volume.

diagnostics.interpretation: Rank-normalized split R-hat and bulk/tail ESS across independent chains. Fan labels are exchangeable; field and volume diagnostics are used instead. Passing diagnostics does not prove global mode exploration or model correctness.
diagnostics.assessment: R-hat <1.01, bulk/tail ESS >=400, zero divergences, every chain's energy BFMI >=0.3. Maximum-depth saturation is a separate efficiency warning. Source-fan normalization must also pass angular refinement at relative tolerance 1e-6.
